!carrinhoRef.current.contains(event.target as Node) ) { onClose() } } if (isOpen) { document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside) } return () => { document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside) } }, [isOpen, onClose]) const handlePaymentDataChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent) => { const { id, value } = e.target
